subject: organic
question:
有机化学·保护基化学：下列哪组反应条件能够脱除所示保护基：TIPS alkyne（triisopropylsilyl alkyne）？
A. TBAF, THF
B. PPTS, MeOH
C. CSA, MeOH, 0 °C
D. DDQ, CH₂Cl₂/H₂O
explanation: A bulky alkyne silyl that survives K₂CO₃/MeOH, so a TMS alkyne can be removed next to it; TBAF removes it.
